027public class TacticallyBombardColony extends HubMissionWithBarEvent implements ColonyPlayerHostileActListener {
028
029        public static float PROB_PATROL_ENCOUNTER_AFTER = 0.5f;
030        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 120f;
031        
032        public static enum Stage {
033                BOMBARD,
034                COMPLETED,
035                FAILED,
036                FAILED_NO_PENALTY,
037        }
038        
039        
040        
041        protected void createBarGiver(MarketAPI createdAt) {
042                List<String> posts = new ArrayList<String>();
043                posts.add(Ranks.POST_AGENT);
044                if (createdAt.getSize() >= 6) {
045                        posts.add(Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR);
046                }
047                if (Misc.isMilitary(createdAt)) {
048                        posts.add(Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER);
049                }
050                if (Misc.hasOrbitalStation(createdAt)) {
051                        posts.add(Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER);
052                }
053                String post = pickOne(posts);
054                if (post == null) return;
055                
056                // rank used only when it's an agent, since the other posts mean the person already exists
057                // and doesn't need to be created
058                setGiverRank(pickOne(Ranks.GROUND_CAPTAIN, Ranks.GROUND_COLONEL, Ranks.GROUND_MAJOR,
059                                         Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER, Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN, Ranks.SPACE_ADMIRAL));
060                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY);
061                setGiverPost(post);
062                setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
063                findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
064        }
065        
066        
067        protected MarketAPI market;
068        
069        @Override
070        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
071                //genRandom = Misc.random;
072                
073                if (barEvent) {
074                        createBarGiver(createdAt);
075                }
076                
077                if (!Misc.isMilitary(createdAt)) return false;
078                
079                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
080                if (person == null) return false;
081                
082                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$tabo_ref")) {
083                        return false;
084                }
085                
086                if (barEvent) {
087                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
088                }
089                
090                requireMarketIsNot(createdAt);
091                requireMarketFactionNotPlayer();
092                requireMarketFactionHostileTo(createdAt.getFactionId());
093                requireMarketTacticallyBombardable();
094                requireMarketNotHidden();
095                requireMarketNotInHyperspace();
096                
097                float q = getQuality();
098                if (q <= 0) {
099                        preferMarketSizeAtMost(4);
100                } else if (q <= 0.25) {
101                        preferMarketSizeAtMost(5);
102                } else if (q <= 0.5) {
103                        preferMarketSizeAtMost(6);
104                } else if (q <= 0.75) {
105                        preferMarketSizeAtMost(7);
106                }
107                
108                market = pickMarket();
109                if (market == null) return false;
110                
111                if (!setMarketMissionRef(market, "$tabo_ref")) {
112                        return false;
113                }
114                makeImportant(market, "$tabo_target", Stage.BOMBARD);
115                
116                setStartingStage(Stage.BOMBARD);
117                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
118                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
119                
120                setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, market, "$tabo_completed");
121                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
122                
123                addNoPenaltyFailureStages(Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY);
124                connectWithMarketDecivilized(Stage.BOMBARD, Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY, market);
125                setStageOnMarketDecivilized(Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY, createdAt);
126                connectWithHostilitiesEnded(Stage.BOMBARD, Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY, person, market);
127                setStageOnHostilitiesEnded(Stage.FAILED_NO_PENALTY, person, market);
128                
129                setCreditReward(CreditReward.VERY_HIGH, market.getSize() + 5);
130                
131                if (market.getSize() <= 4) {
132                        triggerCreateLargePatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
133                        triggerCreateSmallPatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
134                } else if (market.getSize() <= 6) {
135                        triggerCreateLargePatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
136                        triggerCreateMediumPatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
137                        triggerCreateSmallPatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
138                } else {
139                        triggerCreateLargePatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
140                        triggerCreateLargePatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
141                        triggerCreateMediumPatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
142                        triggerCreateSmallPatrolAroundMarket(market, Stage.BOMBARD, 0f);
143                }
144                
145                return true;
146        }
147        
148        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
149                set("$tabo_barEvent", isBarEvent());
150                set("$tabo_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
151                set("$tabo_reward", Misc.getWithDGS(getCreditsReward()));
152                
153                set("$tabo_personName", getPerson().getNameString());
154                set("$tabo_systemName", market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
155                set("$tabo_marketName", market.getName());
156                set("$tabo_marketOnOrAt", market.getOnOrAt());
157                set("$tabo_dist", getDistanceLY(market));
158                
159                int fuel = getBombardmentFuel(market);
160                set("$tabo_fuel", Misc.getWithDGS(fuel));
161        }
162        
163        @Override
164        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
165                float opad = 10f;
166                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
167                if (currentStage == Stage.BOMBARD) {
168                        addStandardMarketDesc("Perform a tactical bombardment of", market, info, opad);
169                        addBombardmentInfo(market, info, opad);
170                }
171        }
172
173        @Override
174        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
175                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
176                if (currentStage == Stage.BOMBARD) {
177                        info.addPara("Tactically bombard " + market.getName() + 
178                                        " in the " + market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), tc, pad);                  
179                        return true;
180                }
181                return false;
182        }

187        }

221
222        public void reportTacticalBombardmentFinished(InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
223                        MarketAPI market, TempData actionData) {
224                if (this.market == market) {
225                        if (!isEnded() || isEnding()) {
226                                if (rollProbability(PROB_PATROL_ENCOUNTER_AFTER)) {
227                                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
228                                        e.setDelayMedium();
229                                        e.setLocationCoreOnly(true, market.getFactionId());
230                                        e.beginCreate();
231                                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.VERY_LARGE, FleetQuality.HIGHER, market.getFactionId(), FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, new Vector2f());
232                                        e.triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.HIGHER);
233                                        e.triggerSetAdjustStrengthBasedOnQuality(true, getQuality());
234                                        e.triggerSetPatrol();
235                                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
236                                        e.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue("$tabo_marketName", market.getName());
237                                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("TABOPatrolHail");
238                                        e.endCreate();
239                                }
240                        }
241                        
242                        Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
243                        // need to set non-zero expiration since bombardment code advances the market with 0/very small elapsed time
244                        // a few times, so if set to 0 the value would be removed from memory
245                        market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tabo_bombardedColony", true, 1f);
246                }               
247        }
